summary.tldr: Makes Prince Edward Island one Employment Insurance region for Parts I and VIII of the Act and the related regulations.
what_it_does: Declares Prince Edward Island to be one region when applying Part I and Part VIII of the Employment Insurance Act.
Replaces the current rule that splits Prince Edward Island into the Charlottetown area and the rest of the province for Employment Insurance purposes.
Makes the same change in the Employment Insurance Regulations so the province is treated as one region there too.
who_it_affects: Employment Insurance claimants in Prince Edward Island
summary.background: The current rules treat the Charlottetown Census Agglomeration and the rest of Prince Edward Island as separate regions for Employment Insurance purposes.
